name: What is included in a typical project closeout checklist?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a typical project closeout checklist?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical project closeout checklist includes a final walk-through with the client, completion of all punch list items, obtaining final inspections and occupancy permits, submitting all warranties and operating manuals, and preparing final lien waivers. It also involves financial reconciliation, archiving project documents, and confirming all subcontractors have been paid. This ensures all contractual obligations are met and the project is fully documented.
acceptedAnswer.description: A project closeout checklist includes final inspections, punch list completion, warranty submissions, and financial reconciliation.
